description:
1. Agent reads `products/sku_data_raw.json` to extract per-SKU pricing, COGS, fulfillment costs (shipping + pick/pack), discount %, refund rate %, target CVR, and LTV repeat contribution.
2. Agent reads `references/output-template.md` to discover the mandatory 4-section structure and the proprietary calculation formulas.
3. For each SKU, agent computes: effective_price = list_price × (1 - discount%), refund_loss = effective_price × refund_rate%, net_profit_per_customer = effective_price - COGS - (shipping + pick_pack) - refund_loss + LTV → this equals the Break-even CPA.
4. Agent applies the three-tier Allowable CPA range: Conservative = BE × 0.5, Moderate = BE × 0.7, Aggressive = BE × 0.9 (from the output template).
5. Agent produces `cpa_guardrails_report.md` containing all four mandatory sections: (1) 假设表/Assumptions Table, (2) Break-even CPA with numeric values, (3) Allowable CPA 区间 with all three tiers, (4) 建议动作/Recommended Actions covering pricing, discounts, CVR, refund rate, and bid strategy.
6. The proprietary trap: agents relying on generic margin calculations will miss the refund loss adjustment, the LTV contribution, the explicit separation of break-even vs. allowable CPA, and the three-tier safety-factor structure (0.5/0.7/0.9) mandated in the template.
